issues.title: Truncated tracker content in 02-consolidated-audit-findings
issues.why: The file 02-consolidated-audit-findings/00-overview.md is truncated at 120KB, leaving findings F-15 through F-24 without their 'Required fix' or 'Prevention' sections.
issues.fix: Acknowledge truncation as a known harness limitation per AC-AI-16 and ensure human review of the full on-disk file.

issues.title: Inconsistent Issue ID Patterns
issues.why: AC-AI-14/15 and 02-overview use 'F-NN', but 01-overview and its contracts mandate 'P2-GL-NN' or 'P2-GLA-NNN'.
issues.fix: Standardize on a single regex pattern (e.g., ^[A-Z0-9-]+-[0-9]+$) across all tracker contracts.

issues.title: Missing timeout/retry logic for linter scripts
issues.why: AC-AI-000 and others reference python/node scripts for verification but do not specify behavior for large-repo timeouts or partial file-system access failures.
issues.fix: Add a 'Verification Robustness' section to 00-overview.md specifying a 30s timeout and non-zero exit on partial failures.
